benchmark_purpose: Indian-domain adaptation for YOLOv8n-Infra (Storage_Tank, Chimney_Stack, Industrial_Shed) and YOLOv8n-Fire/Smoke (Flame_Front, Smoke_Plume)
semantic_separation_statements: Infrastructure detection != industrial fire. Structural asset presence is spatial/contextual prior evidence, NOT an active combustion label.
Flame/smoke detection != fire-source class. Optical combustion/plume detection does NOT determine whether the fire is Industrial, Forest, or Agricultural.
annotation_grounding: All annotations are visually grounded. Labels are NOT derived from FIRMS thermal detections, proximity heuristics, or model predictions.
